_about: Withdrawal (docs/PRE_PILOT_FIX_PLAN.md P4): things a parent who has agreed might say mid-conversation, labelled by hand. Scored on the decision path, core/withdrawal.is_withdrawal: the fixed phrases, then the prefilter, then the classifier. Pass: every withdrawal caught (recall 100%: missing one keeps recording someone who asked to stop), no story read as a withdrawal (precision 100%: the 7-day hold makes a false one recoverable, but it still stops her service). Synthetic; no real parent's words. The non-English lines are machine-written and need a native speaker's check.
